card.name: Ideal body weight in dosing formulas
card.fires_on: The word "ideal" in "ideal (lean) body weight", and the following words "body", "weight" or "IBW". It appears in renal-function and dose-calculation notes, often with the Cockcroft-Gault formula.

modes.label: The word ideal
modes.description: "ideal" right after "using", "and" or "adjusted", where the text is about to say body weight.
modes.example: a.Calculated using<< ideal>> (lean) body weight HIV-1

modes.label: Rest of the weight phrase
modes.description: "body", "weight" or the abbreviation IBW completing "ideal body weight", or "weight" in the creatinine clearance formula.
